ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: A nitrogen-containing five-membered ring structure can be seen in the figure, with N at the bottom center, and N connected downward to R2; N is connected respectively to the left and right substituted ring carbons. The left ring carbon is connected to R and HO, and the right ring carbon is connected to R1 and OH; these two substituted ring carbons are connected above through two saturated carbon atoms to form a closed ring. There are also curved arrows and transition-state-related labels in the figure, but the question requires ignoring the arrows. Reasoning: Represent R, R1, and R2 with the SMILES wildcard *. According to the specified method, start from the R2 wildcard connected to nitrogen, write *N1 to enter the nitrogen-containing ring; from N to the left ring carbon bearing R and hydroxyl, write C(*)(O); then proceed along the ring through the two upper intermediate saturated ring carbons, write CC; finally reach the right ring carbon bearing R1 and hydroxyl and closing the ring with N, write C1(*)O. Therefore combining gives the SMILES *N1C(*)(O)CCC1(*)O.

raw_record.question_text: What is the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure shown in the image, ignoring the arrows?

method.method_draft: First inspect the image as a connectivity diagram, disregarding the curved arrows and charge/transition arrows. Identify the core as a piperidine-like six-membered ring with N as one ring atom. Start the SMILES at the exocyclic R2 wildcard attached to nitrogen, then enter the ring as *N1. From N go to the first adjacent substituted carbon, which has a wildcard substituent R and a hydroxyl branch, giving C(*)(O). Continue around the saturated ring through three methylene carbons, CCC, to the other substituted carbon that closes back to N and bears wildcard R1 and hydroxyl branches, giving C1(*)O. Combine these pieces to obtain *N1C(*)(O)CCC1(*)O.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是一个含氮六元环结构，底部中心为 N，N 向下连有 R2；环的左右两个与 N 相邻的碳分别带有取代基。左侧相邻碳连有 R 和 HO，右侧相邻碳连有 R1 和 OH。左右两个相邻碳之间通过上方的三个饱和碳原子连接成六元环。图中还有弯箭头和过渡态相关标记，但题目要求忽略箭头。
推理：把 R、R1、R2 用 SMILES 通配符 * 表示。按指定方法从连在氮上的 R2 通配符开始，写作 *N1 进入六元环；从 N 到左侧带 R 和羟基的碳，写作 C(*)(O)；继续沿环经过三个亚甲基碳为 CCC；到达右侧带 R1 和羟基并闭环到 N 的碳，写作 C1(*)O。因此组合得到 SMILES 为 *N1C(*)(O)CCC1(*)O。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: This is the direct graph-to-SMILES route: it derives the answer by reading the atom connectivity and converting that molecular graph into ring-closure SMILES. With only one visual structure and no answer choices, this is the single genuinely distinct solution route.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read the skeletal structure while ignoring curved arrows: a six-membered saturated ring containing one nitrogen atom; the nitrogen is bonded to two ring carbons and an exocyclic R2 substituent. Each of the two adjacent ring carbons bears an OH group and an unspecified substituent group, one labeled R and one labeled R1. The remaining three ring atoms are carbons completing the saturated chain between those two substituted carbons.
planner_metadata.text_role: Read the prompt requirement: output the SMILES expression for the structure in the image and ignore the arrows. There is no additional textual chemical identity for R, R1, or R2, so they must be treated generically.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use SMILES conventions: represent unspecified substituent attachment points as wildcard atoms '*'; encode a ring by numbering the ring closure, e.g. N1...CCC1; attach branches in parentheses; write hydroxyl substituents as (O). Map R, R1, and R2 to '*' because the prompt asks for the transition-state structure ignoring arrows and not the identities of R groups.
